details.description: ft:gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 is OpenAI's fine-tuning offering built on gpt-3.5-turbo-1106, the GPT-3.5 Turbo snapshot OpenAI released at DevDay on November 6, 2023 with a 16K-token context window by default, improved instruction following, JSON mode and parallel function calling. As the fine-tuning base model, developers use it to train a custom ft:-prefixed model on their own data rather than calling it directly for chat. OpenAI's deprecations page schedules direct chat-completions access to the plain gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 snapshot to shut down September 28, 2026, and fine-tuned models built on this snapshot to stop working October 23, 2026, as OpenAI winds down its fine-tuning platform for new customers.
advantages: Released with a 16K-token context window by default, versus the 4K context of the prior gpt-3.5-turbo-0613 snapshot, per OpenAI's DevDay announcement.
OpenAI reported a 38% improvement on its internal format-following evaluations (generating JSON, XML and YAML) versus the prior GPT-3.5 Turbo version.
Supports JSON mode and parallel function calling, per OpenAI's DevDay announcement.

As a fine-tuning base, benefits from the same steerability, structured-output and custom-tone gains OpenAI documented for GPT-3.5 Turbo fine-tuning, such as consistently responding in a specified language.
disadvantages: OpenAI's deprecations page schedules chat-completions access to gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 to shut down September 28, 2026, and fine-tuned models built on it to stop working October 23, 2026.
No longer offered as a base model for new fine-tuning jobs; OpenAI's current fine-tuning guide lists only the GPT-4.1 family, GPT-4o (vision) and o4-mini (reinforcement) as supported bases.
Superseded within OpenAI's GPT-3.5 Turbo line and absent from OpenAI's current model line-up.
use_cases: Fine-tuning for structured output such as JSON, XML or YAML generation
Fine-tuning for improved instruction-following and steerability
Fine-tuning to match a custom brand tone or voice

sources.title: New models and developer products announced at DevDay
GPT-3.5 Turbo fine-tuning and API updates

notes: The catalog's deprecation_date (2026-10-23) matches OpenAI's deprecations page entry for the fine-tuned 'ft-gpt-3.5-turbo' snapshot group (covers both -0613 and -1106); the same page separately schedules the bare chat-completions gpt-3.5-turbo-1106 snapshot for an earlier shutdown, 2026-09-28. openai.com blog pages return 403 to a direct fetch, so the DevDay and fine-tuning announcement posts were read via their Wayback Machine mirrors instead.
